Name: Acolyte
Description: Temple-raised servant of faith with practiced insight and religious knowledge.

Name: Artisan
Description: Skilled maker and guild-trained negotiator with an eye for detail.

Name: Criminal
Description: A survivor of back alleys and hidden deals, quick with lies and quiet steps.

Name: Entertainer
Description: A performer trained to move gracefully and hold a room's attention.

Name: Guard
Description: A watch veteran hardened by patrols, drills, and reading danger early.

Name: Guide
Description: A pathfinder comfortable in wild places and long journeys.

Name: Noble
Description: Born to influence, trained in history, etiquette, and persuasive speech.

Name: Sage
Description: A dedicated scholar of lore, magic, and recorded history.

Name: Sailor
Description: A ship-tested traveler with balance, stamina, and sharp senses.

Name: Soldier
Description: A drilled fighter used to discipline, hard marches, and battlefield pressure.
